gaps.what: Extent of the Norman principality 1058-1139: drawn as the Caserta province plus Aversa's Cliopatria cell (11 cells), a confidence-1 reading shared with norman-italy and kingdom-of-sicily
Gaeta after 1078 (kept to 1090, loss placed in 1091 at confidence 1)
Lando's hold of the city of Capua 1090-1098 (rebel count) not drawn
gaps.why: out of scope: no rebel dossier

gaps.what: Thin finding 2: the Capua-Benevento personal unions (900-989, 1010-1014) stay drawn in both dossiers; the Pandulf Ironhead page makes them two principalities under one prince, so Benevento should minus the Capua cell or drop its 899 and 1010 gains
gaps.why: out of scope: duchy-of-benevento belongs to another batch (orchestrator decision)

problems: principality-of-capua now runs 861 to July 1139 and owns Aversa and the Caserta block from 1058: kingdom-of-sicily should start its Capua contest in July 1134 (Roger II page: Robert expelled 'By July 1134', Alfonso installed) instead of spring 1138, and the Treaty of Mignano is days after Galluccio (22 July 1139), not 25 March 1139.

norman-italy: its keyframes 1066, 1072 and 1077 still contain three Caserta cells (Cliopatria) that now belong to Capua (it removes the block only from 1085); L1 (Ranulf gains Capua 1038) contradicts Capua L6 (Conrad II gives Capua to Guaimar IV in May 1038); vassal events for Robert II under the duke of Apulia (1129-1132) belong on norman-italy or kingdom-of-sicily.
principality-of-salerno: no Sorrento gain (July 1039) and its Capua region (L9, keyframe 1038-1046) lacks the city-of-Capua cell that Cliopatria's cell leaves out.
duchy-of-benevento double-draws the Capua cell in 900-989 and 1010-1014 (see gaps).

The repair opened seven pages beyond the first-pass five (Richard I, Jordan I and Robert II of Capua, Duchy of Gaeta, Roger II of Sicily, Duchy of Sorrento, Duchy of Amalfi) and re-read four; the budget of five was exceeded because the reviewer's fixes needed them.

Every Capua keyframe is now verdict adjust (each unions Cliopatria's cell with a 12 km circle round Capua, which lies 8 km east of the cell); the resolver's cells of the 1028 and 1034 shapes also miss the city, so those were corrected too.
Not touched: duchy-of-naples (fix), principality-of-salerno (fix), emirate-of-sicily (thin), giudicato-of-arborea (fix).
